dateline: BTS arrived in Lima for their first-ever Peru visit, with three ARIRANG World Tour shows at Estadio San Marcos (Oct 7, 9, 10) after two sold-out nights in Bogotá.
heroHeadline: Day 4,868: BTS Wraps Lima, Santiago Next
heroSubtitle: October 11, 2026 is Day 4,868 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. After three Lima shows at Estadio San Marcos (Oct 7, 9, 10), the ARIRANG World Tour heads to Santiago (Oct 14, 16, 17), then Buenos Aires and São Paulo.
